subtitleNullable: Contains 7 classes of skin cancer and descriptions generated by GPT-4o-mini.
descriptionNullable:
EN. This set consists of 1990 images of malignant and benign oncological diseases, which were formed from The International Skin Imaging Collaboration (ISIC). All images were sorted according to the classification taken with ISIC. The dataset was created based on Skin Cancer ISIC, some duplicates were removed, two categories were removed, 50 images were randomly taken from each category as a test set, and the corresponding descriptions were generated based on the skin disease categories using GPT-4o-mini, where the prompt = f"""Analyze this {category} dermatology image. Describe in medical terms and give a sentence. Use ICD-11 terminology and begin with "a dermoscopic lesion photo of {category} for skin cancer diagnosis,..." """. But remember to change the key in the json file to the .png extension for correspondence.

The data set contains the following diseases:

- basal cell carcinoma
- dermatofibroma
- melanoma
- nevus
- pigmented benign keratosis
- squamous cell carcinoma
- vascular lesion
